benchmark.methodology: One Node process, two actual source roots. Three alternating pairs of the same original Battle Armor prelude + 180 explicit benchmark frames; initial paired warmup excluded. Result fingerprints match across all six measured runs. Guest-call host work only, not browser FPS. Other heavy test processes completed before this pass; network collector remained active.

differentialRuns.scope: Every completed input/timer operation hashes time, visible RGBA, SGS variable descriptors/data and resource descriptors, VM PC, stack index and used stack bytes, syscalls, timers, held keys and serialized saves. Checkpoints locate drift within 100 operations. Raw allocated heap, resource payload bytes and all ARM RAM are not compared by this tool; native helper register/stack/clock coverage is in rom-accelerators.test.mjs.
